scope: E520 v5 profile-only raw-source hash advice, memory.stat diagnostics, exact source map and strict gate preservation; no packet build, provider calls, fit, prediction export, or scoring.

findings.finding: cgroup_memory_stat_snapshot() calls stat_path.read_bytes() and only checks len(raw) against MEMORY_STAT_MAX_BYTES afterward. This can materialize an arbitrarily large memory.stat file before applying the 65,536-byte cap, so the diagnostic read itself is not memory-bounded.
findings.required_repair: Read at most MEMORY_STAT_MAX_BYTES + 1 bytes (and reject/record oversized input before decoding), with a regression test proving the reader never consumes more than the cap plus one byte. Preserve the explicit unavailable/failure status and do not substitute zero or partial counters.

findings.finding: The focused tests cover matching raw digests, registry identity/digest rejection, and abort on page-cache advice failure, but do not currently assert a hard bound on memory.stat bytes read.

checks.portable_source_verification: PASS: source_archive.tar is unchanged and pins the unchanged verify_portable_source implementation. It still checks registry version, exact original identity, observed byte size and registry content digest. The patch wraps only _content_digest, routes only resolved train/valid raw inputs through the advised hash, checks the stat identity tuple before hashing, and delegates all other paths to the original cached function.
checks.hash_advice_failure: PASS: page-cache advice/hash exceptions abort with ProfileAbort; the code does not silently fall back to a plain raw digest.
